workload.caveat: The window ran BEFORE the per-user-client-IP fix, so every virtual user shared 127.0.0.1, tripped DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATED_LIMIT (50/hour) and then AUTO_BAN. That is the control working correctly; it means this window measured an app spending much of its time REFUSING traffic. The RSS conclusion is unaffected - a series flat under rejected load cannot be hiding growth - but the traffic figure should not be read as clean sustained load.

companion.role: attribution-only; indicative, not the conclusion about the main window, which ran without tracemalloc so the RSS series stayed unperturbed
